title: Toasting Etiquette: Egészségedre! and Eye Contact

sections.content:
When raising a glass in Hungary (*koccintás*):
- **Egészségedre!** = To your health! (informal, one person)
- **Egészségetekre!** = To your health! (plural, to a group)
- **Eye contact is mandatory**: You must look the other person directly in the eye while clinking glasses!
- Clinking beer glasses: An old 1849 tradition discouraged clinking beer mugs, though modern Hungarians frequently do today.

items.spanish: Emeljük a poharunkat az ünnepeltre: Egészségedre!
items.english: Let's raise our glasses to the celebrated person: To your health!

items.spanish: Koccintáskor mindig a másik szemébe nézünk.
items.english: When clinking glasses, we always look into the other person's eyes.
